nameEn.description: Standard English anatomical name with abbreviation (e.g., 'Thoracodorsal n.', 'Profunda brachii a.', 'Pronator teres m.')

nameZh.description: Traditional Chinese anatomical name used in Taiwan medical schools (e.g., '胸背神經', '肱深動脈')

description.description: Concise gross anatomy description including origin, course, accompaniment, and innervation/supply

morphemes.description: Etymological breakdown into prefix, combining root/adjective, and noun abbreviation

distractors.description: 2 to 3 plausible distractor morphemes for Duolingo-style word bank quiz

pathwaySummary.description: Continuous anatomical pathway: Upstream origin -> Landmark -> Target structure -> Downstream branches/targets

regionGroup.description: Anatomical compartment and layer grouping (e.g., '前臂屈肌側淺層 4', '臂神經叢後索')

callout.description: Spot-test (跑台) practical identification tip, key companion vessel/nerve, or anatomical landmark

clinical.description: Clinical correlation, anatomical variation, or common spot-exam pitfall
